The '''Power Center cavern''' was one of the ice caverns known collectively as the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Named for the [[Maximum Security Power Center]], which supplied power to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Belsavis prison|prison facilities]] in [[the Tomb]] and [[Maximum Security Section]], it was also home to a complex that the [[Esh-kha]] species converted into their [[Esh-kha sanctuary|sanctuary]], and was split across the middle by a volcanic rift. [[Power Center Imperial Transport|Two]] [[Power Center Republic Transport|transporters]] created by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] were located in small caves along the cavern's walls.<ref name="LOC" />
